title: Reel foncier, interest above rent, carried 10 years
question: Appartement 250 000 EUR, frais 18 000 EUR, loyer 500 EUR hors charges, aucune charge, tranche 41 %, regime reel, pret 240 000 EUR a 3,5 % sur 25 ans sans assurance. Que devient l'excedent d'interets ?
hand_computation: payment 1 201.50; interest 8 302.52 against rent 6 000: the 2 302.52 excess is an interest deficit, never on global income, carried 10 years (R3).
truth_source: Hand computation on 2026-10-11 from rules R1 to R9 of skills/rental-yield-france/references/regles-fiscales.md (service-public.fr F1991, F32744, F1419 checked 2026-04-15; CGI art. 31, 32, 39 C, 50-0, 155, 156; BOFiP BOI-BIC-CHAMP-40-20 and BOI-BIC-AMT-20-40-10-20).
